# Templates

Build once, reuse per product. Copy into `docs/<stage>/NNN-*.md` at the stage indicated.

| Template | Created at | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| [`spec-template.md`](spec-template.md) | Architecture | Product spec, including the required entitlement design and frozen interface contract |
| [`deliverables-manifest.md`](deliverables-manifest.md) | Architecture, maintained throughout | Every deliverable and its build status. Gates what may appear in sales copy |
| [`claims.md`](claims.md) | Architecture, enforced at RC | What may and may not be claimed publicly. Travels into every downstream tool |
| [`release-checklist.md`](release-checklist.md) | Release Candidate | Two-sided sign-off before anything is sold or publicly claimed |

Governed by [`docs/operating-baseline.md`](../operating-baseline.md).
